observations: Line 3: the ternary condition is inverted relative to the stated contract; when name == null it calls name.trim(), which would throw NullPointerException.
Line 3: for non-null input the method returns the literal "" instead of the trimmed value, so surrounding whitespace is not stripped as the contract requires.
Line 3: the parameter shadows the method name (String name in name(String name)), which is legal but reduces readability.
Line 2: method is static and package-private with no null-check guard before dereference on line 3.
Probe p1 Display.name(null) would dereference null on line 3 and throw NullPointerException rather than returning empty.
Probe p2 Display.name(" Ada ") would return "" on line 3, discarding the input entirely.
